next.name: The big shop expansion
next.text: Roughly three times the shop in every category, plus a new premium tier above Master pricing.
items: About triple the tanks, ammo types, home screens and maps
Ammo with genuinely different behavior: unusual trajectories, multi-stage and delayed blasts, new terrain interactions
Five extra premium tanks and five extra premium ammo types, priced for the endgame
Prismatic tanks built from crystal and light, and the Eviscerator, a burning, smoking, red-hot machine

next.name: Tank creation suite
next.text: Build your own tank from parts you have unlocked.
items: Mix a turret, hull, tracks, barrel, glow, ambient effect and accent
Name it, write its lore, preview it, save it and equip it
Custom tanks are stored by stable part IDs, so they survive future updates

next.name: Terminal Tickets
next.text: A very expensive shop item that drops you into a random boss battle against one of ten bosses.
items: Each boss has its own tank, map and ammo, and fights on a level with the strength of the Prismatic King or the Eviscerator
Win to collect every reward plus a new home screen
A beaten boss leaves the pool, so a new ticket never repeats one
Once all ten are defeated, the tickets sell out

next.name: Two-player and LAN overhaul
next.text: More control over matches, and clearer endings.
items: Choose a map or play a random one, with wind on or off, synced across LAN
Leave an active match at any time, with a clear message and a safe return to the menu
Victory and loss screens that name the win condition for both players
Special Attack mode: skip two turns, then fire for a scaled-up, ammo-specific blast that deals 3 damage

next.name: The Mothership showdown
next.text: The final mission gets a proper structure.
items: The Mothership is shielded until both drones are down
A reworked reward screen, where the prizes are the grand prize

next.name: Fixes and polish
next.text: A round of cleanup across the game.
items: Proper scrolling in the shop, with keyboard navigation
Projectiles leaving from the actual barrel on the home screens
The UFO tank hovering above the ground
Glass Cannon moves from 1 HP to 2 HP
Boss Rush starts you on 4 health and shows how many bosses are left
Reward windows show only what you are actually receiving
Buddy System no longer drops you back to the missions menu on a keypress
Master and Secret edition home-screen terrain fixes
Cheat code counts always match the real content

notes.text: Current release: 20 Tournament levels, 50 missions, 52 tanks, 52 shells, 29 special maps and 28 home screens. Save format version 4.
